claim_counting_rule: Unique confirmed canonical defects count only from originally ISSUE observations. Each originally ISSUE observation with no matched defect and adjudicated advisory/refuted counts once as a false claim. A mixed observation matching a defect also counts one false component if the adjudicator explicitly labels a component refuted. This includes reasoning errors and is an auxiliary defect-and-evidence precision, not a uniformly segmented claim benchmark. Original ADVISORY/PENDING observations never gain retrospective positive credit.
